rule: For each intent and language, the first expected destination found in the browser-mirror ranking decides the grade: PASS = rank 1–3; WEAK = rank 4–10; FAIL = absent. The validator fails on any FAIL, and on any WEAK unless the intent records weak_allowed_reason. Expected destinations list the explanatory page first, then Evidence Records that are equally valid answers. Aliases are discovery aids only; no ranking weight is tuned to satisfy this probe.
